people.name: Hermon_Mount
people.line: Mountain on the northern border of Israel

people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir. They have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
translations.bsb: They constructed all your planking with cypress from Senir. They took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
translations.kjv: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts
translations.asv: They have made all thy planks of fir-trees from Senir; they have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for thee.
